answer: In Proof of Agent, each identity locks bonded collateral in an escrow and signs protocol messages anchored to a common beacon. If k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting histories, their correlated penalties scale quadratically, O(k²), while detection applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss, compounded by asymmetric depreciation. A sybil operator therefore gains little from each mirror identity: controlling a swarm around a summit decision increases exposure rather than voting power.
